finding: The eave step aligns with the red upright and bracket supporting a projecting porch. Fascia and shadow continue coherently; the apparent level change is inside a native core, not a native-core join. At full-map scale this reads as different eave depth on the same roof slope.
decision: Keep original p43. Withdraw previous mandatory P2 designation. No generated alternative is integrated.
